title_en: New Slang, New Stories (5/20): "666" Floods the Game Chat
note_en: 没想到 (méi xiǎngdào) literally means "didn't think of" and introduces something surprising: 没想到这一喊，队友还以为又来了个高手 "Who'd have thought: with that one shout, the teammates assumed another pro had joined." English uses "to my surprise" or "who knew," but Chinese simply puts 没想到 at the front of the surprising fact, and it appears four times in this story.
